I answered Marcus in a thread on their message in #north-team: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Marcus is in. Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 during the morning shift. The same trailer appeared twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him by hand. Dana is the account owner and was handling it, so I pointed Marcus to them as well.

Thea's job title appears only in an internal note written for Ruth, not anywhere Marcus can see, so I left it out.
